data.description: This spell functions like dispel evil, except that you are surrounded by constant, blue lawful energy, and the spell affects chaotic creatures and spells rather than evil ones.

raw_tokens.value: Shimmering, blue lawful energy surrounds you granting a +4 deflection bonus to AC against attacks by chaotic creatures and you can choose to drive chaotic creatures back to their home plane on making a successful melee touch attack.|!PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
